correctness.rationale: Appending a symbol partitions deletion descendants into D1(u) and D2(u)a; their overlap consists of the one-deletion descendants ending in a. Retaining the terminal copy or deleting the last two symbols supplies the shorter prefix as appropriate, including the length-one base case. This proves the pointwise binomial(run count,2) plus long runs minus internal singleton returns formula. The increment parametrization is bijective, and on each nonzero block the number of choices at each step is 1 for a return and q−2 otherwise, proving the conditional binomial law even with self-inverse symbols. The centered conditional mean has linear coefficient (m−1)p and square-free pair coefficients 1 (nonadjacent) and −1/(q−1) (adjacent). Independence makes these terms orthogonal; adding the expected conditional binomial variance gives the boxed polynomial and its cubic leading term. Expectation simplifies to 1+(m−1)p+binom(m,2)p²; at m=1 the empty descendant has count one. Independent replay: python3 -B /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 5 used leftmost embeddings and matched exact moments on 26,194 words, for q=2–5 and n=2–6.
